subject.title: fix(agents): prevent canceled and timed-out runs from staying stuck

question: Should this maintainer-labeled draft receive a lifecycle-runtime proof requirement before normal merge review, or are the reported focused Testbox regressions sufficient for this failure mode?
rationale: The patch changes session-terminal and cleanup behavior across asynchronous owners; a maintainer must decide whether the available test-only evidence adequately represents the interrupted-run recovery path.

options.title: Request runtime lifecycle proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or runtime logs that show cancellation or timeout, late callbacks, release of the active run, and successful admission of the next message.

options.title: Accept focused regression coverage
options.body: Proceed with normal review if the owner considers the reported multi-file Testbox coverage sufficient for this internal lifecycle path.
